You'll ship features that make real-time collaboration feel effortless, integrate AI capabilities into intuitive interfaces, and ensure the editor performs flawlessly whether someone is creating their first gamma or their thousandth. This role puts you at the core of Gamma's product: our AI-powered editor, built on CRDTs and WebSockets. You'll shape how users interact with AI-generated content in real time, working closely with backend engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver experiences that feel fast, polished, and magical. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and evolve the core real-time collaborative editing experience using CRDTs and WebSockets - Ship full-stack features that integrate AI capabilities into intuitive, polished user experiences - Optimize frontend performance so the editor feels fast and responsive at scale - Collaborate with designers to implement high-quality UI interactions and visual details - Contribute to and suggest improvements for open-source projects that are core to Gamma's web application - Design APIs with backend engineers to power seamless collaboration and content creation WHAT YOU'LL BRING - 3+ years building production web applications with strong fundamentals in JavaScript, React, and modern web development - Genuine passion for crafting excellent web experiences, with sharp attention to detail in UI implementation - Experience with real-time collaborative systems, WebSockets, or similar technologies, and familiarity with CRDTs or operational transformation for collaborative editing - A curious, low-ego mindset that matches your technical skill - Prior experience building rich text editors or content editors (Nice to have) COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $180K - $310K plus benefits & equity. assistworld-assist-world:lever:3d3f5eb9-.description: About This Role This is a guest-facing email coordination role at a fast-growing luxury travel and concierge company. Day- to-day, you’ll be the primary link between guests and the hotels and suppliers that make their experiences exceptional — gathering trip details, communicating guest preferences to hotels, and ensuring every interaction is warm, accurate, and on-brand. Rate checking is part of the role, but communication is the core of it. This is not a task-and-log-off role. Full presence, proactive thinking, and genuine ownership are expected throughout every shift. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Guest & Hotel Email Coordination (Primary) • Work with guests via email to gather trip information — preferences, special requests, ETAs, and any last-minute needs. • Communicate these details to hotels and suppliers ahead of each arrival, ensuring nothing is missed regardless of whether the client has replied. • Handle VIP1 & VIP2 pre-arrival touchpoints: confirm arrivals, brief hotels, and follow up with both parties as needed. • Maintain a warm, personal, on-brand tone in every message — it should never read like a template. Rate Checking (Supporting) • When a booking comes in, verify the guest has the best available rate by checking the hotel’s public website and/or booking engine — this is confirmation and verification, not proactive deal-hunting. • Where needed, contact the hotel directly for pricing and information. • Flag rate discrepancies and document findings accurately — this is investigative, detail-driven work. • Occasional quoting may be required; when it is, the focus is on retrieving accurate pricing through the right channels, not finding the cheapest option. High-Volume Email Management • Log in, scan the full inbox, triage by urgency, and label before actioning — never work top to bottom. • Prioritise flagged and time-sensitive items first; process supplier confirmations, replies, and new inquiries systematically. • Maintain inbox zero by end of shift — nothing unresolved or unacknowledged. Hotel & Supplier Outreach • Email hotels and vendors to confirm bookings, flag special requests, and follow up on outstanding items. • Where email isn’t getting a response, escalate to a call — but keep most communication via email where possible. Shift Handovers & Notion • Update Notion at the end of every shift with open items, actions taken, and anything the next coordinator needs to pick up. • Keep SOPs and task notes current so the team always has visibility. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR • Genuine passion for travel — you don’t need a CV full of travel jobs, but you need to actually care about this space and want to grow in it. • Thinks on their feet — when something goes sideways, you look for a solution before you escalate. • Warm, polished written communication — professional but personal, never robotic or templated. • Attention to detail — you catch what others miss, before it reaches the guest. • Email triage instinct — you scan, sort, and prioritise; you don’t need to be told what matters most. • Proactive communicator — if you’re stuck, behind, or unsure, you say so early. • Comfortable with ambiguity — workflows evolve, and you adapt without needing hand-holding. • Full commitment — exclusivity required. This role cannot be combined with other employment. SHIFT & AVAILABILITY Schedule Hard start and end times — not a task-completion role Hours 9-hour shift including 1-hour unpaid break (8 productive hours) Start Time Daytime or evening shift TBD — to be confirmed at offer stage Weekend At least one weekend day required (e.g. Sun–Thu or Tue–Sat) Exclusivity No concurrent employment — full focus required from day one TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY Email Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets) Inbox Mgmt Hiver — shared inbox assignments and email tracking Task / SOPs Notion — team handovers, booking details, client info AI Drafting Claude — used to support email drafts and workflow efficiency Security 1Password Commission Cion — commis

Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:81d9e07f-c48.description: Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries. At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms. Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech? Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You’ll Need - Native or near-native fluency in Lao - Based in: Worldwide, Remote - English proficiency - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? 🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow 🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI 🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI. Depending on your skills, you might: 📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems 🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance 💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs) 🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you. How to Apply?
